services.name: Group Tubing
services.desc: Bring everyone. We operate the only tubing vessel on the Jersey Shore that accommodates groups larger than 6 - up to 22 people, two tubes in the water at once, and a USCG captain who knows exactly how to make it a day nobody forgets. The full boat for up to 22 people - captain, all equipment, two couch-style tubes, ice and coolers, and a Bluetooth speaker for your group’s music. The $650 is flat for the boat, not per person, so smaller groups pay the same as a full 22. Gratuity for the captain isn’t included - industry standard is 18% and our captains earn it.
